tools.name: tollbooth_pricing_quote
tools.description: Compute clearinghouse fee and developer net payout across Free BYO x402 (0%), Hybrid (7%), and Tollbooth Pro/Agency (3%) tiers in integer USD microdollars.

tools.name: tollbooth_wallet_balance
tools.description: Inspect an agent wallet credit balance, status, and remaining UTC daily spend cap. Read-only lookup.

tools.name: tollbooth_issue_receipt
tools.description: Issue a short-lived Rail B rcs_receipt_hs256 bearer authorization token against an existing prepaid credit balance. Does not move bank or crypto funds.

tools.name: tollbooth_verify_x402
tools.description: Verify an x402 V2 paymentPayload signature and expiry against paymentRequirements and replay records. Does not execute on-chain transfers.

tools.name: tollbooth_create_topup_checkout
tools.description: Return a Stripe Checkout or sandbox link URL that a user can open in a browser to fund a wallet ($1+) or purchase a Pro ($39) / Agency ($79) Pass. Never charges automatically.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "tollbooth_issue_receipt" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Issue a short-lived Rail B rcs_receipt_hs256 bearer authorization token against an existing prepaid credit balance. Does not move bank or crypto funds.
